import json, hashlib, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
NS="{urn:auger:spec:1}"
m=json.loads(Path("corpora/auger-docs/manifest.json").read_text())
bad=0
for d in m["documents"]:
    src=Path(d["source_abs"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    norm=" ".join(src.split())
    tree=ET.parse("corpora/auger-docs/"+d["document"])
    blocks=tree.getroot().findall(NS+"section")
    assert len(blocks)==d["block_count"], d["source"]
    dig={b["id"]:b["text_sha256"] for b in d["blocks"]}
    for b in blocks:
        body=" ".join((b.text or "").split())
        if body not in norm:
            bad+=1; print("NOT VERBATIM", b.get("id"))
        if hashlib.sha256(body.encode()).hexdigest()!=dig[b.get("id")]:
            bad+=1; print("DIGEST MISMATCH", b.get("id"))
print("documents", len(m["documents"]), "blocks", sum(d["block_count"] for d in m["documents"]), "problems", bad)
EOF
